facts.fact: Tris 想当 Fox 的任务，不知不觉也成了 Christina 的任务
facts.anchor: my mission to become a Fox becomes Christina’s mission, too

facts.fact: Christina 一边教她出拳一边问：他们会不会收一个只有一只眼睛的姑娘
facts.anchor: Do you think they’d take a one-eyed girl?

facts.fact: Colin 提着飞镖枪来找她，说她需要一个能拿得出手的技能
facts.anchor: You need a skill. And I think this could be it.

facts.fact: 她第一次发现自己真正擅长一件事，随后又提醒自己这只是成为 Fox 的手段
facts.anchor: I’ve never discovered something that I’m good at—something real, not a game.

facts.fact: 盛宴上 Gretchen 掀开布，宣布他们把 Dauntless 总部的厕纸整箱偷了出来
facts.anchor: We took it right out from under their noses

facts.fact: Evelyn 自她背规矩那天起没再来过，Tris 觉得只有成为 Fox 才能让她注意到自己
facts.anchor: Becoming a Fox is the only idea I have for getting her attention.

facts.fact: Mender 请她跳舞，贴着她耳朵说自由是被允许的
歌刚结束，一队 Dauntless 哨兵从隧道涌上来，枪口对准他们
facts.anchor: a group of Dauntless sentries surges up from the tunnel, their guns pointed at us
